article_title: The job interview question you don't have to answer

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main advice about being asked for your current salary in a UK job interview?
options: You may choose not to disclose it and can redirect the discussion to expectations, skills and market value.
You must provide it because UK law requires every applicant to answer.
You should always claim a much higher salary to improve the offer.
You should refuse to discuss any aspect of pay during the interview.
tasks.correct_answer: You may choose not to disclose it and can redirect the discussion to expectations, skills and market value.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בבריטניה מעסיק רשאי לשאול על השכר הנוכחי, אך המועמד אינו חייב לחשוף אותו ויכול לדבר על ציפיות שכר, כישורים וערך שוק.

tasks.prompt: What did Louise Rudd say employers should do if they ask applicants about salary?
options: Ask only candidates who have worked abroad
Wait until after the employee starts work
Ask every applicant the same questions so they are treated fairly
Report every answer to the government
tasks.correct_answer: Ask every applicant the same questions so they are treated fairly
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ראד אמרה שאם מעסיקים בוחרים לשאול על שכר, עליהם לשאול את כל המועמדים אותן שאלות כדי להבטיח יחס הוגן.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “obliged” mean in the statement that applicants are not obliged to reveal their salary?
options: Encouraged by friends
Legally or formally required
Paid extra money
Judged by a recruiter
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה מתארת חובה רשמית או משפטית; הכתבה מבהירה שלמועמדים אין חובה כזו לחשוף את שכרם.

tasks.prompt: Which change is being introduced across the European Union?
options: All salaries will be set by the EU.
Applicants will be banned from discussing benefits.
Employers must hire the highest-paid candidate.
Employers will be banned from asking about salary history.
tasks.correct_answer: Employers will be banned from asking about salary history.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שכללים חדשים באיחוד האירופי יאסרו על מעסיקים לשאול על היסטוריית שכר.

tasks.prompt: Why does the Fawcett Society oppose questions about previous pay?
options: They can carry past pay inequalities into a new employer's offer.
They make interviews too short to assess experience.
They prevent companies from advertising open roles.
They force candidates to accept jobs immediately.
tasks.correct_answer: They can carry past pay inequalities into a new employer's offer.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האגודה טוענת שהסתמכות על שכר קודם עלולה לשמר פערים היסטוריים הקשורים למגדר, גזע ומוגבלות.

tasks.prompt: What does “outweigh” mean when the article says the risks of lying can outweigh the reward?
options: Be hidden by
Be equal to
Be greater or more important than
Be calculated after
tasks.correct_answer: Be greater or more important than
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה, הסיכונים של שקר בריאיון עלולים להיות גדולים או חשובים יותר מן התועלת האפשרית.

tasks.prompt: Name two protected characteristics on which UK employers must not discriminate against applicants.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני מאפיינים מוגנים המופיעים בכתבה, כגון גיל, מוגבלות, גזע, דת, מין, היריון ואימהות או נטייה מינית.
expected_points: Accept any two listed characteristics, including age, disability, race, religion or belief, sex, pregnancy and maternity, or sexual orientation.
The answer must identify characteristics rather than general claims about fairness.

tasks.prompt: Summarise three alternatives the article suggests when an applicant does not want to reveal current salary.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול שלוש חלופות מן הכתבה: ציפיות שכר או טווח התפקיד, כישורים וניסיון, ערך ותרומה, והיכרות עם שכר השוק.
expected_points: State salary expectations or show knowledge of the role's salary range.
Focus on skills, experience and the value the candidate can bring.
Research the market rate and discuss the benefits or package that matter.

tasks.prompt: Why might researching the market rate strengthen a candidate's position in a salary discussion?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שמחקר מספק בסיס מציאותי לציפייה, מאפשר להצדיק אותה לפי התפקיד והתרומה, ומפחית תלות בשכר הקודם.
expected_points: Market research provides an evidence-based salary range for the role.
It helps the candidate explain their value with confidence and realism.
It shifts the discussion away from salary history and toward the new role.

tasks.prompt: Write a short, professional answer an applicant could give when asked, “What is your current salary?” without revealing the figure.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: התשובה צריכה להיות מנומסת ומקצועית, לא לחשוף מספר, ולהפנות את השיחה לטווח השכר, לכישורים או לערך שהתפקיד דורש.
expected_points: Politely decline or avoid stating the current salary.
Refer to salary expectations or the advertised market range.
Connect the requested package to skills, experience or contribution.
